Title: General Availability: vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB now supports Mongo Ver 7.0

Body.Content:
We are thrilled to announce that vCore-based Azure Cosmos DB for MongoDB has expanded its capabilities and now supports MongoDB Version 7.0. This is a significant step forward in our commitment to providing the best possible service.

Learn more.
